id: \bJasmine is at the Glitter Lighthouse right now and is not taking any challenges.
en: \bJasmine is at the Glitter Lighthouse right now and is not taking any challenges.
it: \bJasmine al momento è al Faro Lucente e non accetta sfide.

id: \bBrock: Hey \PN. I ran into Jasmine and helped give her Amphy the medicine.
en: \bBrock: Hey \PN. I ran into Jasmine and helped give her Amphy the medicine.
it: \bBrock: Ehi, \PN. Ho incontrato Jasmine e l'ho aiutata a dare la medicina ad Amphy.

id: \bJasmine told me I would find you here if I waited. Now that you're here, let's see how much stronger you are.
en: \bJasmine told me I would find you here if I waited.  Now that you're here, let's see how much stronger you are.
it: \bJasmine mi ha detto che ti avrei trovato qui se avessi aspettato.  Ora che sei qui, vediamo quanto sei diventato forte.

id: \bBrock: That was a great match. You should try going east of Ecruteak City when you're done here. They have a strong Gym Leader.
en: \bBrock: That was a great match. You should try going east of Ecruteak City when you're done here.  They have a strong Gym Leader.
it: \bBrock: È stato un bell'incontro. Quando hai finito qui, prova ad andare a est di Amarantopoli.  Lì c'è un Capopalestra forte.

id: \bThe beach is flooding now, so it is best to stay away.
en: \bThe beach is flooding now, so it is best to stay away.
it: \bLa spiaggia si sta allagando, quindi è meglio starne lontani.
